instruction.name: vssrlrni.w.d
instruction.description: Logical right shift with rounding the unsigned 64-bit elements in `a` and `b` by `imm`, saturate the result to signed 32-bit, write the 32-bit result into the lower half of each 128-bit lane of `dst`, and zero the upper half.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form a vector-register dependency chain. Measured with unroll=100000 to amortise call overhead.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vssrlrni.w.d $vr0, $vr8, 1; vssrlrni.w.d $vr1, $vr9, 1; vssrlrni.w.d $vr2, $vr10, 1; vssrlrni.w.d $vr3, $vr11, 1; vssrlrni.w.d $vr4, $vr12, 1; vssrlrni.w.d $vr5, $vr13, 1; vssrlrni.w.d $vr6, $vr14, 1; vssrlrni.w.d $vr7, $vr15, 1
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vssrlrni.w.d $vr0, $vr8, 1; vssrlrni.w.d $vr1, $vr9, 1; vssrlrni.w.d $vr2, $vr10, 1; vssrlrni.w.d $vr3, $vr11, 1; vssrlrni.w.d $vr4, $vr12, 1; vssrlrni.w.d $vr5, $vr13, 1; vssrlrni.w.d $vr6, $vr14, 1; vssrlrni.w.d $vr7, $vr15, 1'

notes: LSX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with register-only operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
